story.title: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering

draft:
AI might replace many software engineering jobs. 
I've been reading about how AI is changing the landscape of software engineering, making some roles obsolete. 
Key points include automation of routine tasks and increased demand for high-level skills. 
Will AI create new opportunities for engineers or just widen the skills gap? 
#AI #SoftwareEngineering #FutureOfWork
